clips.video_title: Balaji Interview: The American System is Breaking - Bitcoin is the Escape Plan
clips.quote: You could visualize, you know, all 8 billion minds, and you could see Arun starting with Satoshi and then getting to where it is now. You would see it taking this enormous swath of territory from CZ to Pablo Dura, to people in the Middle East, just every ethnic group, racial group, religious group in the world, this message has spread.
clips.why: Self-contained argument about Bitcoin's global adoption and territorial expansion, finishing with a complete thought on the message spreading across all groups.
clips.host_setup: Host introduces Bolognese Shrinivasan, author of the network state.
clips.host_react: Host sets up the conversation with Bolognese, leading into his discussion on Bitcoin's expansion.
